lines.text: God tests Abraham and tells him to offer his son Isaac as a burnt offering in the land of Moriah.
Abraham splits the wood, takes two servants and Isaac, and on the third day sees the place in the distance.
Abraham builds an altar, binds Isaac, places him on the wood, and takes a staff to slaughter his son.
The angel of the LORD stops Abraham, who then sees a ram caught by its horns and offers it instead.
The LORD promises descendants like the stars and sand, and Abraham then settles in Hebron.
